subject: Qorus Systems integration roadmap and product asks
messages:

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Qorus Systems integration roadmap and product asks

Liz — thanks again for the demo last week. Qorus' ISV listing and connector are high priority for their enterprise sales motion and they'd like to align timelines with our marketplace launch window in Q1. I'm putting together a short list of product/engineering asks so we can triage what's feasible in the near term. Can you confirm the following from your side?

- Primary integration target: marketplace listing + seamless SSO + tenant provisioning API. Is that still accurate?
- Must-have timeline: pilot with 2 joint customers by end of Feb. Can Qorus commit engineering support for integration testing in Jan?
- Any technical constraints on SAML/OIDC providers you need us to support?

Cc'ing Jonas/Karthik for technical sizing and to flag anything that would block a Jan integration window. I've attached the initial spec Qorus shared and an internal MVP scope matrix for us to fill.

Attachments: [qorus_integration_spec_v0.3.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)], [mvp_scope_matrix.xlsx (Excel, 42KB)]

Thanks — Camila

Subject: Re: Qorus Systems integration roadmap and product asks

Thanks Camila — yep, that's the set. A couple of clarifications from our PM/SA side:

- Priority: marketplace listing + SSO + tenant provisioning API (in that order). Listing needs marketplace metadata and billing hooks; SSO we prefer OIDC but can support SAML if Redwood requires it.
- Timeline: we can provide two full-time engineers for an 8-week integration sprint starting Jan 5, assuming product decisions from Redwood are final by Dec 15.
- Customer pilot: we have two pilot customers in the pipeline (one US, one EU) — both are ok with Feb pilot if integration is stable by early Feb.

Attaching the integration spec with a section called "non-negotiables" — mostly around user mapping and billing events.

Attachments: [qorus_integration_spec_v0.3.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Nov 2025 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Qorus Systems integration roadmap and product asks

Adding technical context — thanks for the summary. Quick notes from product/engineering: 

- Marketplace listing: straightforward from a metadata/manifest perspective. The billing hook model Qorus proposes (event-based usage + invoice reconciliation) needs a mapping to our existing token/embedding metering. We'll need a short epics doc; suggest we own the manifest and they own their entitlement mapping.
- SSO: we currently support SAML 2.0 + OIDC. OIDC will be better for session refresh and mobile flows; if Qorus can do OIDC that's preferred. If they insist on SAML, we need to schedule a compatibility run (SAML NameID vs email mapping).
- Tenant provisioning API: we have an existing internal API (provisioning v1) but it lacks tenant-scoped quotas; adding quota scoping is a 2-week task (engineering estimate). That's the main blocker for a controlled pilot.

Action items I see:
1) Camila: confirm final product decisions by Dec 12 so we can freeze scope.
2) Camila + Qorus: set up weekly integration sync starting Jan 6.
3) Karthik: triage provisioning API work and estimate effort for quota scoping (I'll create SUP-3456).

I'll draft the short epics doc and link it here once it's up.

Jonas Weber
Product Manager, Integrations | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
[On Thu, Nov 13, 2025 at 08:27 Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com> wrote:]

From: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@qorussys.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 09:16:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Qorus Systems integration roadmap and product asks

Jonas/Camila — quick technical note from our SA: we can do OIDC for the majority of flows. A couple of implementation details to call out:

- SCIM vs provisioning API: Qorus prefers to use your provisioning API rather than SCIM to preserve their internal user model. If quota scoping is added we can avoid a full SCIM implementation.
- Service-to-service auth: recommendation is mutual TLS for the provisioning calls; does Redwood support mTLS endpoints in the private control plane or should we put a gateway token in front of the provisioning API?
- Billing events: we'll emit a usage webhook at the end of each billing window; need a signed webhook verification header — prefer HMAC-SHA256 with a shared secret.

I've attached a quick SSO sequence PNG and a proposed minimal payload for provisioning. Happy to jump on a call to walk the flow.

Attachments: [sso_sequence.png (PNG, 56KB)]

— Rajesh
Rajesh Patel
Solutions Architect, Qorus Systems

Appreciate the quick turnarounds — summary and next steps below: 

Summary:
- Qorus: will prioritize marketplace metadata + OIDC-based SSO + provisioning via Redwood API (avoid SCIM if quota scoping available).
- Redwood: product agrees to add tenant quota scoping to provisioning API (2-week estimate). Jonas to open SUP-3456.
- Timeline: both sides can support an engineering sprint starting Jan 5. Pilot target: early Feb.

Immediate next steps (owners & dates):
- Jonas: create epics doc and SUP-3456 by Nov 21.
- Karthik: provide detailed estimate for quota scoping by Nov 24.
- Liz/Rajesh: share final integration test plan and any security questionnaires by Dec 1.
- Camila: schedule weekly integration syncs (start Jan 6) — I'll send calendar invites this week.

I'll attach the filled MVP scope matrix with the Redwood/ Qorus owners column completed. Can we also confirm whether Qorus needs mutual TLS or whether a gateway token is acceptable? Rajesh, can you call that out in your test plan?
